newsitem.title: UK: Ashurst in deal with McDonnell.
newsitem.headline: Ashurst in deal with McDonnell.

text.p: Minerals and technology group Ashurst Technology Ltd said on Friday its unit Ashurst Government Services had signed a contract with U.S. group McDonnell Douglas Aerospace for aluminium-scandium alloy development.
The contract, worth $75,000, could lead to additional contracts and future licensing agreements and substantial material sales for Ashurst, it said.

Ashurst, listed in Toronto, on the AIM market in London and traded in New York, will develop a new class of aluminium alloys for structural components for launch vehicles, military transport aircraft, commercial aircraft and fighter aircraft.
